run_training_loop: run the pytorch training loop with GPU ids and continue training flag via argparse
parse_gpu_args: parse command line arguments for GPU ids range and continue training boolean flag
run_trainer_make_model: run the Trainer class to create a batch generator and build the model for training
run_forward_backward_pass: run a forward pass through the model then compute loss and perform backward pass with optimizer step
save_trainer_model: save the trainer model state dict along with optimizer state and epoch number to disk
